source_record.bounded_interface_domain: The exact shared item, behavior, configuration, environment, time and used receiving concern stated in the member are established. The source contribution is actually connected to that concern with credible provenance, not merely imaginable tool use. A partial input can be material while other receiver premises remain open. Unknown correspondence is not an established false guard.
source_record.native_common_basis: Integrated behavior supports the observed runtime claim at its tested configuration and environment. It does not by itself establish value, safety, unique identity or every interaction.
source_record.common_cost_and_alternative: Use the smallest representative example, proof or analysis for the actual question; include environment, oracle, retention and duplication costs.
source_record.domain_horizon_authority: Each member exact technical decision, configuration and actual authority; no universal process order or automatic exposure.
source_record.evidence_ceiling: Conditional analytical partial-input relation. No empirical effect estimate, complete receiver entailment, legal applicability judgment, novelty or independent acceptance.

source_record.inference: The explicit contribution is material at its stated guard even when final action is confirmed rather than changed. Corresponding mechanisms may overlap; duplicate names, reused tests and common pipelines do not create additional benefit or independence.
attempted_contrary_interfaces: Identical test behavior treated as unique artifact identity.
A green pipeline treated as exposure authority.
An approved model treated as actual deployed state.
The same test counted as independent evidence twice.
All evidence discarded after harmless change.
All evidence carried after a changed critical premise.
A trace link treated as proof of the linked claim.

positive_controls.argument: Current rationale, interface meaning and operating limits identify what the integrated example actually demonstrates and prevent a future user from enlarging its claim.
Recoverable item and environment identities delimit which integrated state the result describes and whether a later recipient can reproduce that claim.
Actual-state reconciliation identifies deployment and environmental differences that restrict reuse of the integrated result.
The affected-claim analysis identifies which integration evidence is invalidated and which unchanged evidence can remain applicable.
The owned semantic contract and version pair determine which behavior, conditions and counterpart must be exercised by meaningful integration evidence.
A feasible method, stated environment and discriminating criterion define the runtime claim for which integrated execution can supply evidence.
The failure-observability analysis selects the system boundary and conditions required for a relevant integrated example.
Accurate configuration-aware links identify which claim an integration result supports and which change requires that evidence to be reconsidered.
The assurance subclaim, assumptions and defeaters identify the particular runtime question the integrated exercise must answer.
Problem identity, affected state and authorized disposition determine what the integrated regression example must reproduce and what remains an accepted residual.
Explicit model semantics, version and authority identify which model claim is being compared with the integrated behavior.
Reproducible generation, configuration linkage and explicit consumption rules make the integrated result repeatable and interpretable at the relevant decision.
